name: Adjustable Dumbbells (pair)
notes: The single highest-value first purchase; unlocks squat, hinge, push, pull, and carry patterns.

name: Doorway Pull-Up Bar
notes: Needed alongside a resistance band for assisted pull-ups.

name: Weighted Vest (20-40 lb)
notes: Loads squat-pattern work with zero grip or arm involvement -- useful when avoiding grip/arm-load.

name: Drag Sled / Loaded Tire Rig
notes: Heavy leg work pulled from a hip harness -- arm-free.

name: Belt Squat Machine
notes: Heaviest arm-free squat option; a big-ticket item.

name: Barbell + Plates
notes: Enables the heaviest loaded squat/hinge work; grip- and spine-loading.

name: Squat Rack
notes: Needed to safely rack/unrack a loaded barbell squat.

name: Sturdy Table (for inverted rows)
notes: Most households already have one; the free way to train the pull pattern with no other equipment.

name: Sturdy Chair
notes: Most households already have one; unlocks chair dips for triceps-focused arm work.

name: Adjustable Bench
notes: Upgrades floor pressing to a full-range bench press.
